title: 飲み物とカップ麺
lead: アイスコーヒー・コーヒーカップ・カップ麺・ココアなど、飲み物と軽食の素材12点です。カフェのメニューやブログ、SNSに使えます。
subject_en: Flat illustration of drinks and quick snacks, each ONE item centred, simple colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: an iced coffee in a tall glass with a straw
a coffee cup and saucer with steam
an instant noodle cup with a lid half open and steam
a mug of cocoa with marshmallows
a Japanese tea cup with a teapot
a green cream soda with ice cream and a cherry
a glass of orange juice with a slice
a mug of beer with foam
a fruit smoothie in a cup
